Locally distributed frontend assets, pinned in frontend/package-lock.json:

MapLibre GL JS 5.24.0 — BSD-3-Clause
https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js
See MAPLIBRE-LICENSE.txt, including bundled dependency notices.

Terra Draw 1.38.0 — MIT
Terra Draw MapLibre GL adapter 1.5.0 — MIT
https://github.com/JamesLMilner/terra-draw
See TERRA-DRAW-LICENSE.txt.

Map tiles/style are not included in these files. The default public style is
provided by OpenFreeMap, with OpenMapTiles and OpenStreetMap attribution
displayed by MapLibre. https://openfreemap.org/
